test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, E, F, P and Q are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. F sits third to the left of C. Only one person sits between C and P when counted from the left of P. Only two people sit between B and E when counted from the right of E. A is an immediate neighbour of B. Who sits to the immediate left and right of Q, respectively?
solution:
**Given:** A, B, C, E, F, P and Q are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1. F sits third to the left of C.

2. Only one person sits between C and P when counted from the left of P.

3. Only two people sit between B and E when counted from the right of E.

4. A is an immediate neighbour of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3189c7eb9bc9fc4c69efa486182926c55737273683c110def1a0924f9e3b8e69.png] 

Q, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfe3c440b4f6abacb064ef9bbffd7b5e1be9969f9f6f8b621ee098b157e8c58f.png] 

Thus, C and P sits to the immediate left and right of Q, respectively.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
